Planning your next game night? Start building your playlist.

The Just Dance: Decades of Hits Songlist Trailer gives fans a sneak peek at 26 of 35 iconic tracks featured in the game, helping YOU start imagining the ultimate dance party with friends and family. This trailer is your first step toward planning a celebration powered by music, movement, and shared memories.
